boardgameCardFronts.title: Encounter (Red)
boardgameCardFronts.subtitle: "You find a box labeled ‘Not yet’. Do you grab it? Do you open it?"
boardgameCardFronts.alt: Encounter card front: a watercolor and ink illustration of a box labeled 'Not yet'.

boardgameCardFronts.title: Movement (Green)
boardgameCardFronts.subtitle: "Go to a space you have already been to."
boardgameCardFronts.alt: Movement card front: a watercolor and ink illustration evoking a return to a familiar place.

boardgameCardFronts.title: Group action (Purple)
boardgameCardFronts.subtitle: "You stumble upon another player. Share one element of your stories."
boardgameCardFronts.alt: Group action card front: a watercolor and ink illustration of two figures meeting.

boardgameCardFronts.title: Encounter (Red)
boardgameCardFronts.subtitle: "A mirror cracks as you pass."
boardgameCardFronts.alt: Encounter card front: a watercolor and ink illustration of a cracked mirror.

boardgameCardFronts.title: Group action (Purple)
boardgameCardFronts.subtitle: "Everyone shares one key element of their story."
boardgameCardFronts.alt: Group action card front: a watercolor of six colorful meeples huddled together.

boardgameCardFronts.title: Encounter (Red)
boardgameCardFronts.subtitle: "You receive a map with no directions. What do you do?"
boardgameCardFronts.alt: Encounter card front: a watercolor and ink illustration of a map without directions.

boardgameCardFronts.title: Encounter (Red)
boardgameCardFronts.subtitle: "A memory rises, vivid and uninvited. What does it ask of you?"
boardgameCardFronts.alt: Encounter card front: a watercolor and ink illustration of a memory growing wild.

boardgameCardFronts.title: Encounter (Red)
boardgameCardFronts.subtitle: "An echo answers back. Whose voice is it?"
boardgameCardFronts.alt: Encounter card front: a watercolor and ink illustration of two splotchy figures facing each other.

boardgameCardFronts.title: Encounter (Red)
boardgameCardFronts.subtitle: "A wind scatters your thoughts. Do you gather them back? How are they different now?"
boardgameCardFronts.alt: Encounter card front: a watercolor and ink illustration of a figure with thoughts scattering on the wind.
